entries.title: Crewmates keep their full size near the edge of the stage
entries.body: A task's parts circling its mark no longer shrink into a small knot as the mark nears the side of the stage, and a crewmate circling the one it waits on or reviews keeps its full circle. Crewmates may now pass the window's edge or another computer's crew, on your computer, iPhone and iPad.

picture.alt: The first mate with a task's forty parts circling its mark at full size on two wide rings beside it
